done_when: forge test --pytest runs the whole suite for a pyproject.toml change only when its dependency or pytest settings change, and only related tests otherwise; every uv command Forge runs uses the lockfile without rewriting it, so no Forge command leaves uv.lock changed; one command test per case; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each
why: Any pyproject.toml change makes forge test --pytest run the whole suite locally (30+ minutes holding the test slot), and uv run rewrites uv.lock back to an old cached version in older worktrees, leaving stray changes that block closes and cleanup
